ignore_all_headers.description: Wildcard pattern for all headers to ignore by default.

unignore_headers.default: from: subject to cc date x-mailer x-url user-agent
unignore_headers.description: Space-separated list of header fields to explicitly allow through.

hdr_order_fields.description: Space-separated list of header fields to display in this order.

sort_method.description: Sorting method for messages in the index menu.

mixmaster_filter_program.description: Path to the mixmaster filter program.

mime_lookup_types.description: MIME type to look up handlers for using mime.types.

time_inc_value.description: Progress counter upgrade interval in milliseconds.

mailto_allow_headers.description: Space-separated list of headers allowed in mailto: URLs.

attachments_default_include.description: MIME patterns to include as attachments by default.

attachments_vcard_pgp_exclude.description: MIME patterns to exclude from attachments (treat as inline/known).

attachments_pkcs7_exclude.description: MIME patterns for S/MIME to exclude from attachments.

attachments_inline_include.description: MIME patterns to include as inline.

attachments_external_body_exclude.description: MIME patterns to exclude from attachments list.

attachments_external_body_inline_exclude.description: MIME patterns to exclude from inline list.
